slice: MP4-SCAN-003 exact proof slice (not the whole Issue)

environment.memory_measurement: /usr/bin/time -v wrapping each cargo kani invocation; not per-solver cgroup isolation

input_domain.mp4_scan_003: start:u64/end:u64 full numeric values with exact constructor/caller precondition start<=end; up to four symbolic size32:u32/largesize:u64 pairs over full numeric domains. largesize is exact reparameterization and is unobserved unless size32==1
input_domain.production_precondition: top-level scan starts with 0<=len; nested scans enter only from already validated box body boundaries or explicit minimum-length stsd/sample-entry shells
input_domain.excluded_inputs: inputs accepting a fourth valid box before terminal/invalid are outside the small scan model and remain unproven

assumptions.assumption: scan accepts at most 3 valid boxes before terminal/invalid; fourth symbolic entry covers invalid after three valid boxes
one-step measure decrease may be composed mathematically with finite region length
assumptions.classification: human composition only; not machine-proved unbounded termination

coverage.scan_position_exact_complement: Complete iff at==end. TrailingBytes iff at!=end and fewer than 8 bytes remain; BoxStart otherwise. start>end is a production-unreachable total extension classified as trailing
coverage.valid_step_exactness: valid box steps use production mp4_box_boundary_step/mp4_box_scan_next_offset. next_offset==body_end, body containment within end, at least 8 bytes strict progress, remaining measure decrease, and next_offset<=end are checked
coverage.small_scan_model: four potential symbolic headers are unrolled. Inputs with 0..3 valid boxes before terminal/invalid are covered exactly within the declared bound, including invalid fourth header after three valid boxes. Inputs accepting a fourth valid box are excluded and remain unproven
coverage.terminal_exactness: exact end is complete; 1..7 trailing bytes are not accepted as successful scan content and remain production truncated/invalid; size0 terminates at enclosing end; first invalid stops the scan
coverage.measure: finite unrolled transition composition is machine-checked. induction over unbounded box count is not claimed as a Kani-proved result

connection_conditions.production: production top-level scan and nested child_boxes use mp4_scan_position for terminal classification and box_header/mp4_box_scan_next_offset for valid transitions. mp4_box_scan_next_offset delegates one-box arithmetic to mp4_box_boundary_step
connection_conditions.shell: tag interpretation, MediaError text construction, byte reading, and Vec<BoxHeader> collection remain in production shell; boundary/offset arithmetic is not duplicated
connection_conditions.true_to_code: proof invokes production helpers directly. No cfg(kani) replacement, fmt/alloc stub, Cursor, writer fixture, Vec decode, full parser, or diagnostic formatting is in the proof target
connection_conditions.public_contract: public API signatures, public error kinds/text, error precedence, supported formats, normal/error behavior, f64 precision, and partial ingest/capability semantics are unchanged
